page_title: OSA 2-0 ATM | Osasuna v Atletico Madrid 15/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.

90+6' What a chance that is! Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar!
90+2' Mario Melero blows his whistle. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+1' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
90' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) commits a foul and Mario Melero immediately signals a free kick.
88' Vicente Moreno prepares a substitution. Aimar Oroz is replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
88' Ante Budimir will be replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
87' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
86' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mario Melero blows his whistle for a foul.

82' 2 - 0 Goal! Kike Barja hands Ante Budimir (Osasuna) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
81' Juan Cruz is being substituted because of an injury. Vicente Moreno sends Abel Bretones (Osasuna) on the pitch.
79' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
76' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is penalised for holding. Mario Melero signals a set piece.
75' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged offside.
73' Atl. Madrid are seeing far more of the ball now.
72' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Bryan Zaragoza and he is replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
71' The game has come to an end for Pablo Ibanez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jon Moncayola (Osasuna).
71' Rough tackle by Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
70' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Atl. Madrid have a corner.
69' Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
69' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alexander Sorloth will be replaced by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid).
67' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
65' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
64' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Koke will be replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
63' Here is a change. Julian Alvarez is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).

63' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot low towards the middle of the net is denied by Sergio Herrera. This effort didn't really trouble him.
60' Substitution. Kike Barja (Osasuna) replaces Ruben Pena.

59' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
58' Flag goes up against Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
57' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside!
56' Mario Melero blows his whistle as Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
54' Mario Melero has a clear sight and sees a foul from Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna).
52' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) fell very awkwardly and landed on his head. He’s leaving the pitch and Diego Simeone sends on Nahuel Molina to replace him.
50' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
49' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
48' The attendance for today's match is 21171.
46' The game is over for Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid). Samuel Lino comes on for the second half.
46' Diego Simeone makes a half-time substitution. Cesar Azpilicueta comes on in place of Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Mario Melero has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) wastes a huge opportunity after receiving a fine cross from the free kick, but his close-range shot goes well wide of the right post.
42' Dangerous play by Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid). Mario Melero blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
40' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) is cautioned by the referee.
38' Poor challenge! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for tripping and Mario Melero blows his whistle.
37' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
36' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) brings an opponent down and Mario Melero interrupts the game.
35' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post.
35' Sergio Herrera makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) after a cross from the side.
34' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well wide of the right post.
29' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
28' The game is interrupted. Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
25' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) was probably a bit loose with his words to Mario Melero, who decides to show him a yellow.
25' 1 - 0 Gooal! Bryan Zaragoza takes over corner duties. Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 1:0.
25' Osasuna earn a corner.
24' The free kick into the penalty area from Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) is cleared.
24' A clumsy foul by Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) and Mario Melero blows his whistle.
22' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
21' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.

20' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Atl. Madrid have a free kick from a promising distance.

19' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Sergio Herrera pulls off a brilliant save.
17' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Mario Melero interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
15' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
15' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) wins the battle with the defender and plants a header goalwards from the corner, but his effort from around the penalty spot sails harmlessly past the right post.
14' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Osasuna.
14' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
13' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Sergio Herrera comes off his line to intercept.
11' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
10' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Atl. Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
8' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Aimar Oroz (Osasuna), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
7' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar.

6' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) reacted quickly inside the box and got on the end of the resulting corner. He smashed the ball towards the middle, but the goalkeeper pulled off a great reflex save.
5' The ball goes out for a corner. Atl. Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
5' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
3' Mario Melero blows his whistle after Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
2' Foul! Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
2' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Osasuna will have the kick-off.
Mario Melero was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
